column1: (1) A  quorum  for  a  meeting  of  creditors  is  present,  if—

(a)
three  creditors  who  are  entitled  to  vote  or  their  proxies  are
present  or  have  cast  postal  votes;  or

(b)
if  the  number  of  creditors  entitled  to  vote  does  not  exceed
three,  the  creditors  who  are  entitled  to  vote  or  their  proxies
are  present  or  have  cast  postal  votes.
